decisions: Clarify whether the carton box is for shipping, retail display, e-commerce mailer use or product set packaging.
Prepare inner dimensions, packed weight, board/flute direction, quantity range, print requirement and artwork status before RFQ.
Avoid asking only for a generic carton price; structure and usage details drive the supplier review.
